sentences.text: David Chester `` Dave '' Gibbons -LRB- born 14 April 1949 -RRB- is an English comic book artist , writer and sometimes letterer .	letterer	letterer

He is best known for his collaborations with writer Alan Moore , which include the miniseries Watchmen and the Superman story `` For the Man Who Has Everything '' .	Watchmen	Watchmen	Alan Moore	Alan Moore	For the Man Who Has Everything	For the Man Who Has Everything
He was an artist for the UK anthology 2000 AD , for which he contributed a large body of work from its first issue in 1977 .	2000 AD	2000 AD (comics)
